newsitem.title: USA: UniMark sees lower FY 1996 profits.
newsitem.headline: UniMark sees lower FY 1996 profits.

text.p: The UniMark Group Inc said on Monday it expects 1996 net income of $500,000, or $0.07 a share, compared with 1995 net income of $2.9 million, or $0.51 a share.

Sales increased 77 percent in 1996 to $65.2 million from $36.9 million in 1995, due to the acquisition of Grupo Industrial Santa Engracia, a Mexican producer of citrus concentrates, citrus oils and citrus juices, the company said.

UniMark said the sales increase was from acquisitions including Grupo Industrial Santa Engracia, a major Mexican producer of citrus concentrates, and Simply Fresh Fruit Inc, a fruit processor targeting the food service industry.
Also, increased sales in the retail, warehouse clubs and food service channels aided sales, UniMark said.
UniMark said it expects financial results to improve as new frozen product lines, pineapple production and Japanese results improve increase revenues.
